name: print-prep-cmyk
summary: Set 300 ppi without resampling and convert to CMYK for offset print.
when: Final step before handing an image to a printer that asks for CMYK.
photoshop: Image > Image Size (Resample off, 300 ppi), View > Proof Colors, Image > Mode > CMYK Color or Edit > Convert to Profile
notes: Run on a copy and keep the RGB master: do not pass --master, or save the RGB master first. Soft-proof and fix out-of-gamut colors before converting. Ask the printer for their profile; coated-cmyk is only a generic default.
